keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria lacks the Geledi). The page says the realm covered "the Jubba and Shabelle valleys and the Benadir coast" at its height without dating the stages; before the 1843 conquest of Bardera it is drawn on the lower Shabelle and the Banaadir. No area on the page.

New keyframe. "At its height it covered all Rahanweyn territories within present-day Somalia" (Bay, Bakool, the lower Shabelle) plus the "Conquest of Bardera in 1843" in Gedo; the Jubba valley is drawn only at Gedo. No area figure on the page.

ledger.note: 1695: Ibrahim Adeer founds the Gobroon sultanate at Geledi. The infobox gives the period 1695-1911 ("Late-17th century"); "The sultanate was established by the Geledi soldier Ibrahim Adeer", and no founding year is given in the text.

region.text: the Shabelle valley and the Banaadir coast around Afgooye

ledger.note: 1843: Sultan Yusuf Mahamud Ibrahim conquers Bardera. Page: "the Conquest of Bardera in 1843". The page does not say who held it. [Reviewer af-01-x, 2026-10-18: confidence 3 to 2; the page names Bardera, not the Gedo region.]

1911: the Geledi sultanate is incorporated into Italian Somaliland. "The sultanate was eventually incorporated into Italian Somaliland in 1911"; the infobox calls it "complete integration". The page gives none of the earlier protectorate dates (1889, 1892, 1905, 1910).

wars.name: Geledi-Bimaal war
wars.outcome: Sultan Yusuf Mahamud and his brother were killed at Adadday Suleyman in 1848; no border change is on the page.
wars.note: "clash[ed] at Adadday Suleyman in 1848". Ahmed Yusuf, his successor, was killed at Cagaaran in 1878 with his brother Abobokur Yusuf.

certainty.note: The page names places and peoples, never a frontier.

notes: New dossier: Cliopatria has no Geledi row. Pages opened: Geledi Sultanate, Ajuran Sultanate (2). The page dates only the infobox span 1695-1911, the conquest of Bardera (1843), the Bimaal clash (1848), Ahmed Yusuf's death (1878) and the 1911 incorporation. Not on the page: the Italian protectorate (1889/1892/1905/1910), Omani/Zanzibar tribute ('would go on to receive tribute from Said bin Sultan', undated: a vassal_start for oman could be added), the rulers' reign years (the rulers table is empty). Counterpart strings: 'Bardera' (the Bardera jama'a, not a dossier), 'Bimaal'. Italian Somaliland is part of the Cliopatria row italian-africa (af-08). Gazetteer names needed: Afgooye (about 2.14 N 45.12 E, capital; not in gazetteer), Bardera (Baardheere, about 2.34 N 42.28 E, Gedo).
